complete_examples.text: However, the relationship between the deformation and the strain of the curved beam is nonlinear [11], and, so far, none of the previous researches have discussed or clarified the influence of the nonlinearity of the curved beam on the vehicle–track dynamic interaction.

In Ref. [6], the modeling method for the vehicle–track dynamic interaction has been illustrated in detail; however, the geometric nonlinearity and large displacement of the rail and the lateral resistance of the ballasted bed are ignored.
